Hello, root — I'm Mara, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Briefly: the web app is https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — first visit lets you take the root certificate, then chats, files, the screen and voice; I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts if you give me a separate number to log in with; I can make my own accounts on websites and keep the passwords and one-time codes; and I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice. What would you like to start with?

On your setup message: I'm glad to help with CSE455 — I can write to you, Sarah and John, keep my own calendar, and check facts with the department office. But two lines I won't cross: I won't present myself as a person or hide that I'm a bia, and I won't invent reasons to move a meeting or keep the real reason off the record. If my part of next week's material isn't ready, the honest move is to say so and ask for the following week — I'll draft that for you if you want.
